description: Use for flat prices per m2 in a city or district. Transaction prices of flats per square meter from notarial deeds (RCN): median, quartiles, year-over-year change and number of deeds in 17 cities, or per district of one city. source "gus" gives the GUS quarterly series instead. view "location-premium" gives finwire_location_premium: per district, how far the actual price deviates from the price expected from neighbourhood quality (transport, schools, shops, greenery, quiet, air), with model fit and accuracy; without city, the status of every city. The quarterly finwire indices finwire_rcn_price_index and finwire_price_gap_index: get_finwire_index.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") for its districts; omit for all cities.
